name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a large silver-gold resource and received RIGI (large investment regime) status approval in early 2026. The company is advancing toward a development decision with updated mineral resource estimates and active Phase VI drilling.
